title: Giant progenitor comet behind the Taurid meteor stream

tellings.quote: 25 to 30,000 years ago a gigantic comet maybe 50 to 60 mi diameter nucleus or even bigger came it was captured into a a sub jovian orbit

plain: Some 25,000 to 30,000 years ago, a giant comet with a core perhaps 50 to 60 miles across was captured into an orbit inside Jupiter's, and its breakup is said to have created the Taurid meteor stream, a belt of debris that Earth passes through each year. The researcher Randall Carlson tells this, without naming a source, drawing on the astronomers Victor Clube and William Napier and on William Asher. If true, the debris from that comet could have struck Earth in prehistoric times.
